name: BNE Parity Lab
objective: Increase authenticated fleet-wide Battle.net Edition parity, prioritizing player intent, movement, combat responsiveness, and native AI decisions without regressing an exact required cell.
priority: Bind every receipt and worklist to the current hermetic engine identity before choosing work.
Rank player-visible systemic clusters by frequency, independent witnesses, and upstream dependency.
Treat command resolution and movement as the first lane, native AI decisions as the second, and combat/effect lifecycle as the third.
Use the earliest divergence to diagnose a chosen family, never as the global work selector.
Prefer a native/Java causal twin or a transcribed binary rule over visible-state inference.
Minimize authenticated evidence before placing it in agent context.

required: focused tests demonstrably fail without the candidate and pass with it
the selected fixed-denominator family score improves
no previously exact required command cell regresses
global authenticated fleet equality does not decline
at least two independent positive witnesses and one negative or held-out witness support a mapped rule, unless the rule is unconditionally transcribed from the pinned binary
all relevant 52-case corpus inputs are readable and authenticated
receipts identify the exact clean or dirty engine input that produced them
playability and determinism gates finish with zero failures and zero unexplained skips
forbidden_shortcuts: declaring parity from screenshots, playability tests, adapter execution counts, or generated scenario counts
using a partial survey as a full proof
editing or replacing sealed native evidence to make a candidate pass
adding fixture ids, unit ids, mission names, or unexplained fitted cycle constants to production predicates
selecting work solely because it owns the globally earliest divergence
accepting a one-fixture improvement without an independent witness or binary-authored rule
declaring parity from a counterfactual state clamp

safe: offline native capture in an isolated harness directory
bounded counterfactual replay in the test trace harness
offline named predicate slicing from authenticated branch history
requires_human_or_agent_commit_decision: committing or merging a tournament winner

context_budget.primary_handoff: current engine identity -> current player-intent worklist -> selected minimized packet -> PARITY.md historical detail only as needed
